description: Fauji Foods Limited was founded in 2015 after the acquisition of Noon Pakistan Limited, a company with an over 50-year dairy legacy that was incorporated in 1966. It operates under the umbrella of the Fauji Group of Companies, with major shareholding by FFBL. Its brands are Nurpur — relaunched as the House of Nurpur in May 2016 — and Dostea, a liquid tea whitener introduced in February 2016.
headOffice: 42 CCA, DHA Phase-VIII (Ex Park View), Lahore, Pakistan
